question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Amputate
solution:
The correct answer is "Sever".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "amputate" typically refers to the surgical removal of a body part, especially a limb.
 
 
• For Example - The doctors had to amputate the patient's leg to stop the spread of the infection.
 
 
 
• "Sever" is the most similar in meaning as it also refers to cutting off or ending something abrup tly, just as an amputation would.
 
 
• For Example - The company chose to sever ties with its long-time supplier due to ethical concerns.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 3".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Brighten: To make something lighter or more luminous, or to become cheerful or animated. 
 
• 
 
Energise: To give vitality, enthusiasm, or vigour to; to invigorate or stimulate.

 
 
• 
 
Argue: To present reasons or evidence in order to dispute or show that something is not true, likely, valid, etc.
